dominant_strengths: Serif headline pairs reasonably with the warm cream background, giving a slightly editorial tone over a generic white shell
Clear list hierarchy with consistent row heights and predictable affordance via the plus icon on each item
Restrained palette avoids visual noise, letting the question text carry primary attention without competing accents
dominant_weaknesses: Massive empty top zone breaks vertical rhythm; the FAQ floats orphaned without anchoring header, intro, or supporting context
Cards are flat white slabs on cream with no shadow, border weight variation, or accent—reads as wireframe rather than finished UI
Plus toggles are small, low-contrast, and visually disconnected from row tap targets, weakening the interaction signal
fix_priorities: Add an intro paragraph or eyebrow above the H1 and tighten top padding to eliminate the dead space
Differentiate cards with subtle border, shadow, or divider system and increase typographic contrast between question and chrome
Strengthen the expand affordance: larger icon, hover/active state, or animated chevron for clearer behavioral feedback
Introduce a category accent color or subtle texture to give the page a memorable identity
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral usability is acceptable but visceral appeal is muted and reflective resonance is near zero due to generic execution.
rationale.intent_fit: It technically delivers FAQ content but the layout feels like an unfinished template rather than considered content design.
